messages:
maria: Draft RC relnotes for v0.9.4 pushed to GH — PR #4123. Need quick sweep on SDK snippets, migration note for embed streaming, and a short known-issues section. Ping if you can look before EOD.
sam: taking a look now. Are we keeping the embed streaming deprecation note?
maria: yes, short blurb + migration steps. Also need to update Go and Python snippets to new client API (client.embed vs client.embed_stream).
alex: I can update Python, but need exact example of new return shape. anyone have final shape?
liz: attach sample from runtime test harness: ```python
resp = client.embed(model='rwd-mini-embed-1', input='doc')
print(resp['embedding'][:8])
``` — that's the new one. remove streaming example.
sam: ok updated Go snippet in PR branch, pushed commit 5f3a. docs-bot: CI check?
docs-bot: CI: docs-lint passed, snippet-tests failed: 2 failures in sdk-snippets/test_embed.py
maria: @liz can you run snippet-tests locally? Might be transient token issue.
liz: running now... yep failing due to timeout at 2s in harness. increasing timeout to 10s fixed locally. I'll push patch.
alex: also saw a broken link in migration guide -> /v0.8/embeds -> 404. I fixed anchor in PR.
maria: perfect. Known issue to include: "embed-streaming deprecation: previously streaming endpoint removed on 2026-04-01; existing clients using client.embed_stream will get 410. If you need streaming, use websocket proxy + batching (link)."
sam: suggest we phrase it less scary, include rollback steps: code snippet to detect 410 and fallback to client.embed.
maria: good idea. Add small snippet: ```js
try{ await client.embed_stream(...)}catch(e){ if(e.status==410){ await client.embed(...)} }
```
liz: also add internal note: Dedicated customers on older runtime will be auto-migrated; include contact link to enterprise-support@redwood.ai
sam: scheduling: want this merged by 17:00 PT. I'll +1 if tests pass.
maria: thanks. tagging release lead @alex to sign off on final wording.
alex: signing off pending docs-bot green.
docs-bot: CI: all checks passed. Deploy preview: https://deploy-preview.prod.redwood.ai/rc/0.9.4/docs-relnotes
maria: deployed preview looks good. small nit: "KV cache" paragraph needs hyphenation fix.
sam: fixed in branch, pushed.
liz: I ran a linkcheck script: found one external link to https://old.example.com/api that 302s — replaced with https://docs.example.com/new-api
maria: final: I'll merge at 16:45 PT. Thanks everyone :tada:
sam: :thumbsup:
